## `neuro.iterator.return`

Instance method on `Iterator.prototype`.



## Signatures

```ts
return(input: { iterator: <receiver>; value?: TReturn; prompt?: string }): Promise<IteratorResult<T, TReturn>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Iterator.prototype.return` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
